description: The single source of truth for the landmark features: read by src/edgevision/spec.py (training, export, the offline live pipeline) and web/src/spec.ts (the browser demo). Change a value here, not in code. Values marked as derived are written by scripts/calibrate_live.py from the train or val split only.

dataset.name: asl-signs
dataset.raw_format: long rows (frame, type, landmark_index, x, y, z), x and y normalised by the frame width and height

selection.face: dropped: no face or lip points are selected

coordinates.z: dropped: training never used z, so the different z scales of Holistic and the Tasks landmarkers do not reach the model

missing.raw: NaN for every point of an undetected block
missing.hand_presence: a hand is present in a frame when all 21 of its x and y are finite
missing.frame_filter: frames with no present hand are dropped before every other step
missing.model_rule: a point is missing when x == 0.0 and y == 0.0; derived features of missing points are 0.0

dominance.rule: mirror when the left hand is present in strictly more kept frames than the right; ties keep the right
dominance.mirror: x -> 1 - x, swap the hand blocks, swap every selected pose_swap_pair, swap the presence columns

normalization.center: nanmedian over kept frames of the shoulder midpoint
normalization.scale: nanmedian over kept frames of the shoulder distance
normalization.fallback: hand_fallback when no kept frame has both shoulders: center = nanmean of all hand points, scale = the larger side of their bounding box

resampling.coordinates: linear between finite values of each coordinate; positions before the first or after the last finite value stay missing
resampling.live_axis: kept-frame clock: every kept frame advances the clock by its own capture interval (the time since the previous captured frame, capped at max_gap_ms), so a constant frame rate gives exactly the training positions

model_input.layout: per frame: the selected landmarks landmark-major [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...], then presence_left and presence_right

aspect.derived: scripts/calibrate_live.py: train_width_over_height = f_train / face_ratio_reference, with f the eye-to-mouth height over the eye distance in normalised image coordinates (pose eyes 2 and 5, mouth corners 9 and 10; f = physical ratio x width / height), f_train its median over the train split's frames (iqr: its quartiles), and face_ratio_reference the physical ratio of MediaPipe's canonical face mesh (canonical_face_model.obj: eye centres from corners 33/133 and 362/263, mouth corners 61/291: 6.97 cm over 6.30 cm). The same estimator gives 1.318 on 640 x 480 Holistic landmarks (true 1.333).
aspect.correction: y' = y_mid + (y - y_mid) * k on every landmark of a frame, about that frame's shoulder midpoint y (default_y_mid without both shoulders); x unchanged
aspect.frame_k: k = train_width_over_height / (width / height) of the frame given to the landmarkers

calibration.description: the body-ratio alternative: k = r_train / median r_live over 2 s, r = |y_nose - y_shoulder_mid| / |x_left_shoulder - x_right_shoulder|

trackers.hands: MediaPipe Tasks HandLandmarker, 2 hands, VIDEO mode
trackers.pose: MediaPipe Tasks PoseLandmarker, 1 pose, VIDEO mode
trackers.face: not used: the model has no face or lip points

hand_assignment.description: Holistic crops each hand from the pose: left_hand is the hand at pose landmark 15 (the signer's left wrist). A detected hand goes to the block of the nearer pose wrist; two hands take the pairing with the smaller total distance. Without a pose the handedness label decides; Tasks HandLandmarker reports the true handedness on an unmirrored frame.

live.mirroring: landmarks come from the unmirrored camera frame; only the preview is mirrored

motion.points: wrist and the five fingertips of every present hand
motion.units: shoulder widths per second, on aspect-corrected coordinates
motion.scale: shoulder distance of the frame, else the last known one, else hand_scale_factor x the wrist-middle MCP distance
motion.speed: mean displacement of the points between the frame and the latest earlier frame at least window_ms older (the oldest kept frame while the hand is newer), over the scale and the time between the two frames
motion.energy: the largest speed among the present hands; 0 for a hand seen in one frame only; none without a hand

segmenter.derived: scripts/calibrate_live.py on the val split (12573 sequences, frames 30 fps apart before resampling): start_energy = P10 of the per-sequence peak energy; still_energy = the largest value with at most 5% of sequences still for still_ms inside the sign; preroll_ms and tail_ms = median lead-in before start_energy and median tail after the last frame above still_energy
